Name: Custom Tool Effect
Author: ZaneYork
Description:
Custom Tool Effect is a Mod for Stardew Valley, it allows you modify Tools effect range and power by edit mod config.

[size=4]INSTALL[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into[code] ﻿Stardew Valley/﻿Mods﻿.[/code]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]USAGE[/size]
1.Default config:
[list]
[*]Modify range of watering can range to 5x5
[/list][list]
[*]Modify range of hoe range to 5x5
[*]Modify power of tools to 140% of origin (180% for Iridium one)
[*]Modify radius of bomb to 140% of origin (150% for mega bomb)
[/list]2.Modify the config file to create your own preference.
[size=4]
COMPATIBILITY[/size]
[list]
[*]Test with Stardew Valley 1.4.5 on Windows and 1.4.5.145 on Android.
[/list]
[size=4]SEE ALSO[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/ZaneYork/CustomToolEffect]Source Code[/url]﻿
[/list]
